{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the value counts of 'revenue' again
print("Value counts of 'revenue':")
print(df['revenue'].value_counts().head(10))

# Now, explicitly check for the string '999999.99' in the revenue column
count_sentinel = (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()
print(f"\nNumber of rows with revenue == '999999.99': {count_sentinel}")

# Now, filter out those rows
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Check the shape
print(f"\nShape of df_clean: {df_clean.shape}")

# Check if any sentinel rows remain
remaining = df_clean[df_clean['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"\nNumber of remaining sentinel rows: {len(remaining)}")

# Print the first few rows of df_clean
print("\nFirst few rows of df_clean:")
print(df_clean.head())"}
